## Engineering Disciplines

### 1. Mobile & Media Systems (Android TV & Kotlin)
- **Specialization**: D-pad navigation ergonomics, low-latency video streaming, adaptive bitrate HLS pipelines, and memory optimization on low-end embedded hardware.
- **Architectures**:
  - Model-View-Intent (MVI) and Clean Architecture with decoupled state machines.
  - Google Media3 ExoPlayer integration for hardware-accelerated playback of MPEG-DASH and HLS (M3U8) streams.
  - Multi-threaded pagination and in-memory LRU caching achieving 0ms navigation delays across 25,000+ media entries.
  - MergingMediaSource audio/video multiplexing for 4K UHD video rendering.
  - Zero-telemetry offline-first architecture using Room DB and SQLite for user privacy.

### 2. Full-Stack Web Engineering
- **Specialization**: React 19 architecture, component modularity, performance budgeting, responsive glassmorphic interfaces, and cloud-native databases.
- **Architectures**:
  - React 19 / TypeScript / Vite build pipeline with sub-second HMR and tree-shaken chunk splitting.
  - Supabase Cloud PostgreSQL with automated trigger functions for default SKU variant provisioning.
  - Row Level Security (RLS) enforcement protecting relational entities at the database layer.
  - WebGL / Three.js 3D rendering optimized with visibility state detection and hardware acceleration.

### 3. Business Intelligence & Enterprise Analytics
- **Specialization**: Relational database architecture, Star Schema modeling, advanced DAX time intelligence, and automated reporting pipelines.
- **Architectures**:
  - Star schema design isolating fact tables (orders, revenue, returns) from dimension tables (customers, products, calendar, regions).
  - 24+ custom DAX measures for Year-over-Year (YoY) velocity, rolling moving averages, margin contribution, and dynamic threshold anomaly detection.
  - Relational PostgreSQL data pipelines leveraging recursive Common Table Expressions (CTEs), multi-table joins, and window functions (DENSE_RANK, ROW_NUMBER, LAG/LEAD).
  - Automation of manual payroll and reporting pipelines reducing turnaround times by ~30% for 500+ institutional records.
